answer.read: Nordmark announced a 6.5 % increase to €370.96 citing copper (+47.7 % on 20 % of its cost, consistent with news:20260910-27). Should-cost (cost:350011, €374.95 ±5 %) and our full-cost estimate (€356–369) suggest it is near break-even, and the goal is stabilise, so squeezing below a sustainable margin adds a relationship charge. Its history (asked +4.7 %, settled +1.2 %) shows it moves from its opening ask. Its OTD of 90.4 % is below the 95 % target, which gives us leverage. Its price on our terms is €344.42 after one reply, so its pace is still unknown. Its status is open and its stated copper fear makes an index clause valuable to it.
answer.message: Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers. We understand the copper pressure, so we propose an index clause on the copper notation that shares the real movement with you, together with longer payment terms and a lower base price. Our volumes for this part are growing, and we would like to keep a stable, reliable supply relationship on terms that are sustainable for both sides.
